Gravi pumps.
	For crazy double jumps (JUMP key). 
	|- Can kill some enemies.
	|- Stops the grips from working
txt_cp1:
Mag Grips.
	Hold on where you want, when you want. 
	|- Let you hold on to platforms for a limited time.
txt_cp2:
Nitro Charger.
	Blast your shoes! 
	|- Lets you crouch to charge a jump. 
	|- Lets you brake hard

Quantizer.
	You will never lack speed again.
	|- Lets you make devastating tackles on some enemies (DOWN key).
txt_cp4:
Reaction Breaker. 
	Without control, speed is useless.
	|- Lets you stop double jumps to take back control (DOWN key).
